name: Jabin
bio: This Jabin was the Canaanite king who ruled Hazor in the time of the judges — sharing his name with the earlier king of Hazor whom Joshua had destroyed generations before, likely because "Jabin" served as a dynastic title passed down through Hazor's royal line. When Israel did evil in the LORD's sight, he was given into this Jabin's power; his army commander Sisera oppressed Israel for twenty years with nine hundred iron chariots (Judges 4:1-3). The prophetess Deborah and Barak, acting under the LORD's command, crushed Sisera's army, and Sisera himself was later killed by Jael; Israel's strength grew steadily afterward until they finally destroyed Jabin, king of Canaan (Judges 4:23-24).
